import json, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','submission/main.py')

doc = json.load(open('examples/edge.input.json'))
ixps, rib, priors, declared, order, queries = mod._parse(doc)
agg={}

    print(p,'->',n)

    t=tuple(n); agg[t]=agg.get(t,0)+c
print(agg)
paths=list(agg.items())
